name: Sweet Scoops
desc: An assortment of ice cream scoops. Four different flavors are served in separate paper bowls and packed together in a single box. Tasters usually fall into two camps: those who dig into whichever flavor they feel like, and those who finish each bowl in order. Either way, there is never anything left at the bottom of the box at the end.

value.text: Increases all party members' ATK by 272 and CRIT Rate by 8% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
